{{Top}}
[[File:Sinkhole.png|thumb|right|250px|A sinkhole formed following the Battle of Malastare.]]
'''Sinkholes''' were large holes on the surfaces of several [[Planet/Legends|planets]], including [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]] and [[Karatha]]. The inhabitants of Utapau were forced to live in the sinkholes because of the strong winds on the surface. They were divided into several different levels. [[Pau City/Legends|Pau City]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]], was located in a sinkhole.

There were smaller sinkholes beneath some of the ponds on [[Skip 6]] on the [[Smuggler's Run/Legends|Smuggler's Run]].<ref name="The New Rebellion">''[[The New Rebellion]]''</ref>

A sinkhole was formed on [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]] after the [[Battle of Malastare/Legends|detonation]] of an [[Electro-proton bomb/Legends|electro-proton bomb]].<ref name="TZB">{{TCW|The Zillo Beast}}</ref>

The [[Blob racing|Umgulian blob races]] happened on a sinkhole stadium.
